segments.pv40:1.3: Taṃ dāni me na [na dāni me taṃ (sī. ka.)] paribhogameti,
segments.pv40:3.3: Rudato ca me [dūrato ca me (syā. ka.)] assukā niggalanti,
segments.pv40:8.1: “Iṅgha tvaṃ gantvāna piṭṭhito gaṇheyyāsi [iṅgha tvaṃ piṭṭhito gaṇha ucchuṃ (sī.)],

lines: Khajjāmīti khādiyāmi, asipattasadisehi nisitehi khādantehi viya ucchupattehi kantiyāmīti attho.
Tassetaṃ kammassāti ettha etanti nipātamattaṃ, tassa kammassāti attho.

Gahetvāna taṃ khādi yāvadatthanti therena āṇattiniyāmena ucchuṃ gahetvā yathāruci khāditvā mahantaṃ ucchukalāpaṃ gahetvā therassa upanesi, thero taṃ anuggaṇhanto teneva taṃ ucchukalāpaṃ gāhāpetvā veḷuvanaṃ gantvā bhagavato adāsi, bhagavā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ taṃ paribhuñjitvā anumodanaṃ akāsi, peto pasannacitto vanditvā gato, tato paṭṭhāya yathāsukhaṃ ucchuṃ paribhuñji.

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: Bhagavati veḷuvane viharante aññataro puriso ucchukalāpaṃ khandhe katvā ekaṃ ucchuṃ khādanto gacchati.
Atha aññataro upāsako sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo bāladārakena saddhiṃ tassa piṭṭhito piṭṭhito gacchati.
Upāsako dārakaṃ parodantaṃ disvā taṃ purisaṃ saṅgaṇhanto tena saddhiṃ sallāpamakāsi.
So pana puriso tena saddhiṃ na kiñci ālapi, dārakassa ucchukhaṇḍampi nādāsi.
Upāsako taṃ dārakaṃ dassetvā “ayaṃ dārako ativiya rodati, imassa ekaṃ ucchukhaṇḍaṃ dehī”ti āha.
Taṃ sutvā so puriso asahanto paṭihatacittaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā anādaravasena ekaṃ ucchulaṭṭhiṃ piṭṭhito khipi.

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: So aparena samayena kālaṃ katvā ciraṃ paribhāvitassa lobhassa vasena petesu nibbatti, tassa phalaṃ nāma sakakammasarikkhakaṃ hotīti aṭṭhakarīsamattaṃ ṭhānaṃ avattharantaṃ añjanavaṇṇaṃ musaladaṇḍaparimāṇehi ucchūhi ghanasañchannaṃ mahantaṃ ucchuvanaṃ nibbatti.
Tasmiṃ khāditukāmatāya “ucchuṃ gahessāmī”ti upagatamatte taṃ ucchū abhihananti, so tena pucchito patati.

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: Athekadivasaṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya gacchanto antarāmagge taṃ petaṃ addasa.
So theraṃ disvā attanā katakammaṃ pucchi –

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: “Idaṃ mama ucchuvanaṃ mahantaṃ, nibbattati puññaphalaṃ anappakaṃ;

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: Taṃ dāni me na paribhogameti, ācikkha bhante kissa ayaṃ vipāko.

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: “Haññāmi khajjāmi ca vāyamāmi, parisakkāmi paribhuñjituṃ kiñci;

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: Svāhaṃ chinnathāmo kapaṇo lālapāmi, kissa kammassa ayaṃ vipāko.

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: “Chāto kilanto ca pipāsito ca, santassito sātasukhaṃ na vinde;

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: Pucchāmi taṃ etamatthaṃ bhadante, kathaṃ nu ucchuparibhogaṃ labheyyan”ti.

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: “Pure tuvaṃ kammamakāsi attanā, manussabhūto purimāya jātiyā;

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: Ahañca taṃ etamatthaṃ vadāmi, sutvāna tvaṃ etamatthaṃ vijāna.

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: “Ucchuṃ tuvaṃ khādamāno payāto, puriso ca te piṭṭhito anvagacchi;

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: So ca taṃ paccāsanto kathesi, tassa tuvaṃ na kiñci ālapittha.

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: “So ca taṃ abhaṇantaṃ ayāci, dehayya ucchunti ca taṃ avoca;

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: Tassa tuvaṃ piṭṭhito ucchuṃ adāsi, tassetaṃ kammassa ayaṃ vipāko.

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: “Iṅgha tvaṃ gantvāna piṭṭhito gaṇheyyāsi, gahetvāna taṃ khādassu yāvadatthaṃ;

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: Teneva tvaṃ attamano bhavissasi, haṭṭho cudaggo ca pamodito cāti.

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: “Gantvāna so piṭṭhito aggahesi, gahetvāna taṃ khādi yāvadatthaṃ;

before.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: Teneva so attamano ahosi, haṭṭho cudaggo ca pamodito cā”ti.

after.title: Ucchupetavatthuvaṇṇanā
lines: So aparena samayena kālaṃ katvā tāvatiṃsesu uppajji.
Sā panesā petassa pavatti manussaloke pākaṭā ahosi.
Atha manussā satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā taṃ pavattiṃ pucchiṃsu.
Satthā tesaṃ tamatthaṃ vitthārato kathetvā dhammaṃ desesi, taṃ sutvā manussā maccheramalato paṭiviratā ahesunti.
